title: Missing ownership check lets any authenticated user read another tenant's invoice
preconditions: knowledge or enumeration of invoice id
root_cause: Handler loads invoice by id without comparing invoice.tenantId to session.tenantId.
description: Invoice lookup is keyed only by the URL id; no ownership check exists on the read path.
expected_behavior: Users can read only invoices belonging to their own tenant.
actual_behavior: Any authenticated user can read any invoice by id (verified with two test tenants).
impact_description: Cross-tenant disclosure of billing records and PII.

evidence.result: User of tenant B received tenant A's invoice (HTTP 200, matching fixture).

observations: 200 with other tenant's row; control (own invoice) also 200
reproduction.cleanup: Fixture tenants destroyed by test teardown.

suggested_remediation: Scope the lookup by tenant (where id and tenant_id) and add a regression test for cross-tenant read/write.
